from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('lig_rh.mol',removeHs=False)
p=m.GetConformer().GetPositions(); rh=19
# preorganize donor distances with forcefield of organic ligand (Rh replaced by external fixed point)
b=Chem.RWMol(m); b.RemoveAtom(rh); lig=b.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(lig)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(lig); ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(lig,props)
ep=ff.AddExtraPoint(*p[rh],True)-1
for n in [8,11,18]: ff.AddDistanceConstraint(ep,n,2.12,2.12,200)
ff.Initialize();ff.Minimize(maxIts=1500)
q=lig.GetConformer().GetPositions()
q-=p[rh]
# expose one side of rh towards Cp, opposite the N3 face
axis=-np.mean(q[[8,11,18]]/np.linalg.norm(q[[8,11,18]],axis=1)[:,None],axis=0);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
x=q[8]-q[18];x-=np.dot(x,axis)*axis;x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
y=np.cross(axis,x)
rot=np.stack([x,y,axis],axis=1)
q=q@rot
cp=Chem.MolFromMolFile('cp.mol',removeHs=False);r=cp.GetConformer().GetPositions();ring=[0,2,4,6,18]
center=r[ring].mean(axis=0);r-=center
_,_,axes=np.linalg.svd(r[ring]);
if np.linalg.det(axes)<0: axes[2]*=-1
r=r@axes.T
# Orient Cp to reduce contacts with NNN ligand. Keep a right-handed rotation.
syml=[a.GetSymbol() for a in lig.GetAtoms()];symc=[a.GetSymbol() for a in cp.GetAtoms()]
rad={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'F':1.47,'H':1.1}
cut=np.array([rad[x] for x in syml])[:,None]+np.array([rad[x] for x in symc])[None,:]
best=None
for flip in [False,True]:
 for angle in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,180,endpoint=False):
  rz=Rotation.from_rotvec(np.array([0.,0.,angle])).as_matrix()

  if flip: xyz=xyz@np.diag([1,-1,-1])
  xyz=xyz@rz.T; xyz[:,2]+=1.82

# save atom list/bond map for checking

for mol,offset in [(lig,1),(cp,1+len(q))]:
 for b in mol.GetBonds():bonds.append([offset+b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),offset+b.GetEndAtomIdx(),b.GetBondTypeAsDouble()])
import json
